deadline.value: International PhD applicants apply by November 15; other PhD applicants by December 1.

gre_general.value: The GRE General Test is not on the School of Graduate Studies list of programs that require it.
gre_general.quote: The GRE General Test IS required by the following graduate programs: Biomedical Sciences-Dental School, Epidemiology and Human Genetics, Oral and Experimental Pathology, Physical Rehabilitation Science*, Marine Environmental Estuarine Studies and Nursing**.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: Students do three laboratory rotations before choosing a lab, so admission is not tied to a named supervisor.
supervisor.quote: They build skills through a series of three rotations in different laboratories

funding.value: Students accepted into GPILS PhD programs are funded for the full time needed to finish the PhD, typically four to six years.
funding.quote: Financial support is ensured for the duration of time required to complete the PhD

also.quote: Students accepted into any of the Graduate Program in Life Sciences' PhD programs receive financial support from NIH-funded training grants, mentor grants, and/or other University of Maryland, Baltimore sources

entry_route.value: The program page does not say whether a master's is needed.

notes: Umbrella GPILS admission; Molecular Microbiology and Immunology and other GPILS PhDs are separate tracks not saved here.
name: Biochemistry and Molecular Biology
